name: ConvertWordToPdf
label: Convert Word To PDF
description: Converts a Word document (.doc/.docx) into a PDF file.

fields.name: InputFilePath
fields.label: Input File Path
fields.description: Full path of the Word document (.doc or .docx).

fields.name: OutputFilePath
fields.label: Output File Path
fields.description: Full path where the PDF should be saved. If empty, PDF will be saved in same folder.
